responsibility: Contains the main RTL machine description for IA-64 instruction selection and expansion. It defines the target’s unspec codes, instruction attributes and bundle classes, core insn patterns for moves, predication, control flow, stack and EH support, pointer extension, prefetch and probe instructions, and includes the companion predicate, constraint, vector, atomic, and division md fragments that together drive recog, reload, scheduling, and final asm output.
same_name_distinction: The RTL machine-description member of the ia64 group: unlike ia64.cc's C++ hook implementations and ia64.h's preprocessor/type definitions, this file encodes instruction patterns, attributes, expands, and included md fragments that drive recog, scheduling, bundling, and final instruction selection; unlike ia64.opt, it is not an option-definition file.
